create.title: Create network
create.body: A network lets containers reach each other by name.

attachable.label: Attachable
attachable.helper: Lets standalone containers join an overlay network. Only for overlay networks on a swarm.

subnet.label: Subnet
subnet.helper: In CIDR form. Bayplan warns if it overlaps another network but doesn't pick one for you.

overlap.one: This overlaps {{name}} ({{cidr}}). Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.
overlap.two: This overlaps {{count}} networks: {{first}} and {{second}}. Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.
overlap.many: This overlaps {{count}} networks: {{first}}, {{second}} and {{more}} more. Containers on both networks may not reach each other. You can still create it.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to do that. Your access may have changed.
errors.nodeUnreachable: That node isn't reachable right now. Try again when it's back.
errors.hostReadOnly: This host is read-only. Changes are turned off on the host itself, so Bayplan can only read from it.
errors.gatewayOutside: The gateway must be inside the subnet.
errors.rangeOutside: The IP range must be inside the subnet.
errors.attachableOverlayOnly: Only an overlay network on a swarm can be attachable.
errors.overlayNeedsSwarm: An overlay network needs a swarm. This environment isn't one.
